facts.fact: 叙述者清晨穿着亮片衣回屋，被等在门口的 Abi 一眼看穿她昨夜在外过夜。
facts.anchor: No one wears sequins in the morning.

facts.fact: 石头上系绳这一发现让 Genevieve 夜里外出失去意义，她反而成了最不可能动手的人。
facts.anchor: The rope around the rock meant that Genevieve’s nighttime excursion was meaningless.

facts.fact: 叙述者认定 Dan 最可能在石头上系那根绳。
facts.anchor: No one was more likely to have tied a rope around that rock outside than he was.

facts.fact: Genevieve 当众用讽刺把父亲的关心顶回去。
facts.anchor: “Yes, daddy dearest, everything is great,” she snapped.

facts.fact: Genevieve 主张自己是唯一亲生女儿，骨灰怎么办该由她一人决定。
facts.anchor: I think I’ve deserved the right to make my own decision, without anybody’s input.

facts.fact: 管家被顶撞后发出一声近乎嚎叫的哭，抽着气冲出餐厅。
facts.anchor: a sob so harrowing it was closer to a scream or howl

facts.fact: Samuel 承认自己与那个男人有过多次亲密关系。
facts.anchor: We were intimate. More than once. A lot of times.

facts.fact: Samuel 承认二十年的沉默只因怯懦。
facts.anchor: “Nothing,” replied Samuel, looking at the two of them miserably. “Nothing but cowardice.”

facts.fact: Genevieve 低声说那个人当年才十八岁。
Samuel 那句「不再有秘密」是说给自己听的。
facts.anchor: It was obvious he was saying it to himself.
